Patch Set 3:

(4 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Some concerns, see inline comments. The default catch-all rule no longer gets its per-RPC delay computed, so the def_rate throttle it is supposed to install does not take effect and the TBF throttle timer is armed on a past deadline; that part needs a refresh. The remaining comments are minor and can ride along.

commit.message:
LU-20099 nrs: use nrs_ratecfg data struct to manage rate conf

This patch defines a data structure nrs_ratecfg to manage rate
related configuration for NRS rule via the NRS command interface.
